image_description: A black and white photograph showing the interior of a prison cell block. The perspective looks down a corridor flanked by vertical iron bars on both the left and right sides. In the background, there is a solid wall with a closed door and a small window or vent near the floor. A hanging light fixture illuminates the arched ceiling. The scene conveys a sense of confinement and utilitarian architecture.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The floor texture appears slightly noisy and uniform, lacking the specific wear patterns or grout lines expected in a high-traffic institutional corridor, though this could be due to low lighting or film grain.

The vertical bars on the right side show slight inconsistency in spacing and thickness towards the foreground, potentially indicating minor geometric warping common in AI generation, though it could also be lens distortion.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image is correctly classified as a prison/correctional facility and not a generic basement or jail set.
To verify the spatial consistency of the arched ceiling and the depth of the corridor, ensuring the bars and walls align correctly in 3D space.
To check for fusion artifacts where the bars meet the floor/ceiling or where they overlap, ensuring they are distinct, solid objects.
To assess the noise levels and lighting consistency, distinguishing between artistic film grain and AI-generated texture smearing.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the iron bars (continuity and connection points)
Perspective consistency of the arched ceiling and corridor walls
Texture realism of the floor and walls under low-light conditions
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the vertical bars with the floor and ceiling. AI often fails to render these connections cleanly, resulting in floating bars or melted bases. Also, evaluate if the 'film grain' look is consistent across the image or if it masks structural blurring in the background.
